about_the_game:
After losing her home and family, our 19-year-old protagonist—whose name is chosen by the player—enrolls at Saint Mika Women's University to finish her studies and rebuild her life.

She’s always been very shy, so she hopes her roommate will be the same, so she won’t have to interact too much. To her surprise, not only is her roommate energetic and outgoing, but she’s also hiding a secret: she’s actually a fox girl searching for a magical item called the Love's Heart!

Explore an all-girls campus, attend regular classes, become the smartest of them all, build a harem or stay true to your one true love, help the fox girl Katsune find the Love's Heart through the main story, meet numerous main characters—12 in total—and many more side characters, each with their own personality and backstory, deepen your relationship with them, and unlock interesting content.

Warning: This game features characters with dark pasts, including the protagonist herself, but all of them can have happy endings—though that depends on your choices. This game also deals with controversial topics such as incest and NTR, but all of this is entirely avoidable; as I said, it’s completely up to the player’s decisions. In fact, you can complete the entire game without kissing or having sex with any character, if you so choose.

Planned content for future updates:

  • Popularity system and dating your classmates. Starting in Chapter 2, you'll be able to chat, get to know, and go on dates with all your classmates who aren't main or secondary characters. That’s 22 more girls added to your list of potential romances. The better your relationship with them, the more your popularity bar will increase. You’ll be compared to your classmates, like Kokoro and Yuri, and you'll be able to surpass them and become the most popular girl in the class. Some girls will have requirements to go out with them, like being good at studying and other things I’ll figure out later.

  • Jobs. I’m planning to let you leave campus and look for jobs around the city starting in Chapter 2. This won’t just give you money to buy gifts for the girls or even food to carry around and recover energy (in case you don’t feel like going to eat), but also energy drinks to earn more study points (still under consideration). Plus, it’ll open the door to meeting even more side characters you can build relationships with.

  • Exams. Unlike in the original game, exams haven’t been implemented yet. Once they are, they’ll work just like in the original game: each month is split into four weeks. Every Monday, there’ll be an exam, and each one will require more study points to pass. You earn study points by going to class and studying—either in your room or at the library (if I remember, I might add books to the shop that you can read to gain more study points, like in Persona 4). At the end of the month, your study points will reset to 0, and exam difficulty will restart. If you fail an exam, Professor Mia will punish you with BDSM sexual scenes. If you manage to pass all four exams with 100 points, you’ll unlock a special sexual scene with Professor Mia. As a tip, now’s your chance to stack up study points while exams aren’t in the game yet, so you can unlock that scene! Don’t worry if you fail the exams—it won’t hurt your relationship with the main girls. However, as I said, they’ll be requirements for dating some of your classmates.

  • Random Events: To bring more life to the campus, there will be random events every day. For example, two girls you’d usually find at the gym at a certain time might not be there, and instead, you could catch them having sex in the locker room. Then you could choose to spy on them, ignore them, or even join them if your relationship is high enough. There will also be random events involving Professor Mia, whom you might catch in her office spanking a student or taking her to her secret room. My plan is to include as many events as possible so every day feels different!

And many more things I haven’t thought of yet. I hope you like my ideas and support my game! I plan to make it the most ambitious and biggest yuri game in history!

content_descriptors.notes: The sexual content involves engaging in sexual relationships with the girls, suggestive scenes and voyerism.
